title: FBI Photo B10
what_is_it: A monochrome still image (photo) captured by a U.S. military sensor system, submitted by the FBI to AARO as a UAP report.
interpretation_warnings: The displayed date (12/31/99) is confirmed incorrect due to unset system clock — the actual incident occurred in late 2025.
Heavy redaction: the original imagery was altered before submission, and most HUD/overlay text is illegible or obscured.
No mission report was provided, so there is no operational context for the image.
The OCR-extracted text is largely garbled and unintelligible, suggesting the image quality is very poor or heavily redacted.
Single-source observation with no corroborating sensor data or witness reports mentioned.
The narrative description explicitly warns readers not to interpret it as reflecting any analytical judgment or investigative conclusion.

verifiable_claims.claim: The image displays a timestamp of 12/31/99 18:10:50
